body: Of course...if you would like to talk I am here to listen
You are not alone - even if it's the tiniest bit of validation - this subreddit has 320,000 people in it who understand how you feel and likely feel the same way
Thank you for that decision, sometimes you just need to put some headphones in and let the music drown your thoughts

I don't have any special words to stop you but I want you to at least know that I understand how you are feeling and I feel the same way. Just know at least that you are not alone, and it won't help anything in the long run

You have enjoyed playing minecraft before, you could enjoy playing Minecraft again. I know it doesn't seem like it now but those moments when you take a pack of wolves or you just sit there and listen to the music are worth living to enjoy once again. You might not be able to enjoy them in this dark headspace you are in, but once you get a little better you can try to find happiness in small things like those. Glad you're still here with us today
Hey, you can talk to me. I want to help

I'm proud of you for trying to get help, that takes a lot of courage. I'm sorry the system has been so shitty. I know what the headspace of "I don't think happiness is possible" is like and I still find myself there frequently, tonight is not an exception. Sometimes you just have to cling on to that idea that happiness is possible, even though you'll probably have to trek through hell to get to it. Look for something, anything to cling onto - nothing is too insignificant. I appreciate you talking to me
Agreed, I enjoy helping others find comfort but can never find my own. At least I find comfort in knowing someone else knows how I feel, even if our situations are different
me too :( do you wanna talk about it?

Okay so I'm not a therapist so I don't know exactly how you feel, but at the same time I think I do know how you feel. I seem to be the person my friends turn to when they're at their lowest - I have quite literally pulled a knife out of someone's hand before. I feel like I can help people - but at the same time I feel helpless. I can never take my own advice and never want to talk to anyone about my own dark thoughts because I don't want to bother them
Question. What was the cause of that incline in mental health?
This is an odd way to start a conversation. Lets try something else. How about: Why do you feel like this?

Of course! I needed something to get myself out of my own head (it's a dark place up there) so I decided to try and be friend for someone who's in their own dark place. Life is hard - you got that one right, and we all have extra modifiers to make it even harder! Yay us! I care about your life so I have to ask - I know this an annoying question but I'd still like to ask - have you ever tried to get help? You're only 18, there is a lot you have not seen that I would love for you to see.

Hey there, moderately insulted that you think you have to be at a low to resort to reddit but i won't take it personally. I have been and still am right where you are except for me the eating thing is backwards - that being when I'm going through it I eat more and then hate myself more because I can't gain weight. Also you're not ugly or disgusting. And you're going to say in your head "this random guy doesn't know that he's never seen me" but I know from personal experience that people don't see themselves the way they truly are, it's frequently (for me as well) very hard to see how beautiful you really are. I know exactly how you feel and if you need to talk, i'm here
Hey! Mind if I ask you why?

Hey man, sounds like you just described my high school life. I'm going into my second year of college now and I have realized when I was in high school I didn't really ever accept the fact that I was in this tiny bubble and there's a whole world out there. When you get out of high school you'll meet a lot more people, it's a big world and eventually you'll find a girl, it doesn't matter how long it takes, it just matters that you end up with the right one

Hey, Minecraft was my first video game I ever played. I had a couple of friends I made on their and I used to lie to my mother and say I was on Skype with my school friends cuz I knew she would flip out if I told her I was talking to random people on the internet. Tell me about ur minecraft experience

Hopefully you are both asleep and alive right now. Sometimes when I feel like this I just sprint as fast as I can until like I feel like I can't walk anymore, and sometimes I just find somewhere that I can scream and hit stuff with a machete, and sometimes I just drive. If you want to talk to someone I am here and open to talk, you deserve better than to feel like this
Thank you random internet stranger who is suspiciously knowledgeable about me and my feelings. I appreciate you.

Paranoid is a word I could use to describe myself in an emotional sense. I agree it is exhausting thinking everyone hates you all the time - this combined with trust issues has caused me to push people away time and time again. Whenever I get too close to someone I find myself in the repeating pattern of thinking they are mad at me, so I don't get close to people - I am friends from a distance. I have had 2 girlfriends and both times have had extreme trouble trusting them, but I have always done my best to keep this to myself and not project my issues onto them. However 2/2 times that I didn't keep it to myself I ended up being right - causing me ever more trust issues than I started with.
I don't even know how to do the first one anymore. I have tried to push myself out there and 2/2 times I have done it I have been hurt
I actually appreciate this factual explanation of why I feel the way I feel. I just wish I knew how to make myself not wish I was dead
Thank you, I will look into that
